author: Vox
description:
MAGA and the progressive left together make up less than 40% of Americans. So who makes up the rest?

Vox’s Christian Paz took the new Pew Research political typology quiz, which breaks Americans into nine distinct political groups. He found that the results paint a much more nuanced picture of why the country feels so divided.

Take the quiz yourself on Pew's website.
